verdict.rationale: Kling publishes per-unit USD prices by mode, duration and audio option (e.g. $0.35 for a pro 5s image-to-video, $0.126/sec for std motion control), so a marketer can work out costs before generating. It also documents prepaid packages and that failed generations consume no credits. However, nothing shows an in-product cost estimate at generation time, and spend tracking afterwards is only implied by team 'shared credits and centralized billing'. Missing for 10: pre-run credit/dollar estimate shown in the UI or API, usage/spend history or dashboard, budget or quota alerts, independent corroboration.
